# Evidentia

> Governed Generative Engine Optimization platform and Agent Skill for European organisations. Built and maintained by Clixite SRL — Belgium.

Note on this file: llms.txt is a community proposal, not a standard adopted by search or answer engines. As of September 2026 Google states it ignores such files and large-scale studies found no correlation with AI citations. We publish it because it is harmless and occasionally useful to people; we do not claim it affects visibility.

## Product
- [Product overview](https://evidentia.clixite.eu/product): capabilities from trusted knowledge to measurement.
- [Architecture](https://evidentia.clixite.eu/architecture): TypeScript monorepo, Node.js 24, SQLite, framework-free core.
- [Installation](https://evidentia.clixite.eu/installation): platform, console and Agent Skill.

## Method
- [GEO / AEO methodology](https://evidentia.clixite.eu/geo-aeo): evidence tiers and the readiness-v1 score.
- [AI visibility](https://evidentia.clixite.eu/ai-visibility): repeated sampling with Wilson intervals.
- [Trusted knowledge](https://evidentia.clixite.eu/trusted-knowledge): provenance, claims, entities, quarantine.

## Trust
- [Governance](https://evidentia.clixite.eu/governance): policies, registers, approvals, ledger, provenance.
- [EU readiness](https://evidentia.clixite.eu/eu-readiness): per-framework controls and responsibilities, no badges.
- [Security](https://evidentia.clixite.eu/security): threat model summary and disclosure policy.
- [Licence and attribution](https://evidentia.clixite.eu/licence): clean-room relationship to GEOFlow (AGPL-3.0).
